faq.title: Renovation FAQ — Pricing, Process & What to Expect | IdealHub
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our Klang Valley renovation process, pricing, timelines, and more. Turnkey renovation for apartments, condos, and landed homes.

mainEntity.name: What renovation package is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer three service categories: Essential Rental Setup (lights, fans, aircon, curtains), Minor Renovation & Refresh (painting, repairs, upgrades), and Complete Renovation (space planning, built-in carpentry, furniture, appliances).

mainEntity.name: What types of properties do you renovate?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily renovate residential properties including serviced apartments, condominiums, landed homes, SOHO units, and studio apartments across Klang Valley.

mainEntity.name: How long will my renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential Rental Setup takes from 2 weeks, Minor Renovation & Refresh from 2 weeks, and Complete Renovation from 1 month onwards. We provide a project timeline before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can you work within my budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Share your preferred budget and we will recommend the most suitable package and prioritise the works that matter most. Budgets range from RM 15,000 to RM 70,000.
Our process is simple: (1) Share your requirements via floor plan, photos, and budget. (2) We prepare the quotation. (3) We renovate and hand over with progress updates throughout.

mainEntity.name: What does a Complete Renovation include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Complete Renovation includes space planning and design, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and painting works, ceiling and feature-wall works, custom carpentry (kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, TV consoles), furniture, curtains, bathroom accessories, and optional appliances.
All renovation works come with a 3-month workmanship warranty. Materials and appliances are covered by their respective manufacturer warranties.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a renovation quotation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send us your floor plan, photos or videos of the unit, and a brief description of what you need. Include your budget and target completion date, and we will prepare a clear quotation based on the agreed scope.
